gloss: to expect; to anticipate; to estimate

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {見込|みこ}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to expect; to anticipate; to forecast
definitions.explanation: to predict or expect something to happen or be the case based on available information

definitions.gloss: to see potential in; to have high hopes for
definitions.explanation: to recognize someone's potential or ability and expect great things from them

examples.english: We're expecting sales of 10 billion yen.

⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五百人|ごひゃくにん}ほど⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見込|みこ}んで⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見込|みこ}んで⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見込|みこ}む (to expect [amount/result])
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{見込|みこ}まれる (to be expected to ~)
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見込|みこ}んで (expecting/anticipating ~)

USAGE:
Sense 1 is common in business and formal contexts for forecasts and projections. Sense 2 is used when expressing trust in someone's abilities.
